text_block_list.text:
One day, some time after summer training 
camp had ended.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I heard Brian is 
back! Word is she's running a mock race 
today.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"We can't be spacing out either! First, 
let's tackle the perimeter with all we've 
got, Trainy!"

Seeing Hishi Amazon in such high spirits 
brings a smile to my face. Just then—

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Brian-senpai in last place? You've 
gotta be kidding.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
No, seriously. Like, her running form 
looked different from before, too.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Looks like she's going for one more, why 
don't we go take a look anyway?

Rumors were flying about Narita Brian 
being in poor condition.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: I wonder if Brian-senpai is okay...

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
It's just because I just got back from a 
break, right? It's only for now, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Brian...!

The gates open, and the Umamusume burst 
forth.

Just like before, Narita Brian positioned 
herself toward the rear of the midfield, 
running with composure.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, gasp*...!

"And coming off the 4th corner into the 
home stretch. As everyone watches with 
bated breath—"

There wasn't even a trace of her 
miraculous late charge; unable to break 
out from the pack, she was left behind, 
finishing the race in 12th place.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what's wrong with Brian-senpai. 
Her old intimidating presence is 
completely gone.

Whether she noticed those voices or not... 
Narita Brian didn't twitch an eyebrow, 
steadfastly staring down at her feet.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...Brian... You...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...What's with that look on your face?

Hishi Amazon's murmur faded into the 
cloudy sky.

Curfew was approaching. Just as I was 
wondering whether I should say something 
to the dead-silent Hishi Amazon—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...Sorry to always lean on you like this. 
I can't go around making faces like this 
in the dorms, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Still, whenever I remember the look on 
their face just now...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing you clench your teeth without even 
twitching an eyebrow like that, man...!"
Hishi Amazon tightly clenched her fist.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: She must've been so devastated...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
She never tells anyone, and she never 
shows it either! She doesn't care in the 
slightest about being understood!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I can tell. I know just how deep 
in the gutter Brian is right now...!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...Dammit...!

For quite a while after that, Hishi Amazon 
couldn't stop sobbing.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...*sniffle*...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: —Gaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Quit blubbering non-stop! That ain't like 
you at all, Big Sis Hishiama!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Dammit, time for distance running! I'll 
run, clear my head, and go right to sleep!

And so, we hastily moved to the training 
grounds at night, and――

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Haa...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Huh!? Brian, and the President!? Why 
are...

Narita Brian and Symboli Rudolf were 
running side by side.

"The race rounded the fourth corner into 
the final stretch. Symboli Rudolf showed 
no mercy."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haaah—!

The gap that had opened between the two 
widened even further. The two figures who 
fought fiercely on that distant day were 
no longer there.
However, even so—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Oraaah!!

Even so, Narita Brian dashed across the 
finish line with everything she had.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Brian...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm fine, I can stand. Sorry for 
taking up your time, Rudolf."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, I felt like running anyway. 
More importantly... did you find your 
answer?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...Indeed. Just as I imagined, the 
scenery has stopped. But—

Narita Brian stared straight at Symboli 
Rudolf with an unwavering gaze.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'll run in the Tenno Sho (Autumn). 
There's no problem with that.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...I see. I'm rooting for you, Brian.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "Trainy... I... was a total idiot."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "Narita Brian" hasn't changed one bit.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
True, that monstrous running style of hers 
is gone. But before people ever called her 
a monster—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: She was someone who simply yearned to run.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: That's why she is... "Narita Brian"...!

Before I knew it, Hishi Amazon's eyes were 
blazing with a fiery passion.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Narita Brian" will never, ever stop 
running!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
That's why she's definitely gonna crawl 
back up. And when she does, she'll stand 
in my way once more.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Then for me—for us, nothing changes! 
Right, Trai-ner!"

With a refreshed mindset, the days of 
striving once again toward the Japan Cup 
began.
